title: Bolster (Hell Knight)
problem: Text: "less damage from attacks and spells". The block has no damage-type test, so it cuts every hit your creature takes, including indirect damage (Burning, Poison, reflected damage...). Good for the player, but not what the text says.
notes: Community claim: Affects all damage, not just attacks and spells. Evidence: bc_EventDamage L2092-2095: creature.slot > 0 (@0x140e061b0) && perk 58 (@0x140e06372) -> amount x (1 - hp / hpmax) (@0x140e063c6-0x140e0664b); no dtype read. Fix sketch: T: "less damage" (all damage), or H: add a damage-type test Triage 2026-10-26: Ruling 2026-10-26 (stat/scope/trigger wording): text matches code. Reduces all damage types, indirect included. 2026-10-26: text correction shipped via localization_override (loader text module). | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "less damage from attacks and spells". Fix: H: call-site hook on the perk-58 gate at bc_EventDamage L2092-2095 (@0x140e06372) returning false when dtype == -1 (indirect). vs bugged: weaker (no longer cuts indirect damage). Hook batch R (loader/hooks_R.c, research/hooks_R.json). In-game test: Bolster at low Health: Burning / Poison (indirect) damage is no longer reduced; attacks and spells still are.

release_notes.intended: Your creatures take 1% less damage from attacks and spells for every 1% Health they're missing.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, indirect damage (Burning, Poison, reflected damage) was reduced too.
release_notes.fix: Now only attacks and spells are reduced.
